title: ÐMP v2 cancel (advisory)

list_id.description: inscription id of the current list op for the dog (spec-v2 §9)

asig.description: spec-v2 §7.2 signature by the order key over the canonical cancel

asigs.description: multisig orders: exactly m asig by distinct script keys in key order

$comment: No ts: cancels are bound to list_id, not ordered by §6.1. Without asig/asigs the reveal must be signed by the order key (§7.1). Authorization, 'current list', and m are checked by spec-v2 §7/§9, not by this schema. A cancel is advisory; only moving the dog is authoritative.
